answer: One enforceable rule: sample three unrelated data feeds and require independent corroboration. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The island of work and the sparrow of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a bridge to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
